apps.name: Paint by Moonlight
apps.subtitle: Turn any photo into a painting
apps.localizedDescription: Turn your photos into paint-by-numbers canvases, entirely on device, and paint them with a finger or Apple Pencil. Built for iPad, works on iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Merge claude/project-thread-9cwdgx: lively paint, kit paint's hues spread, in SideStore builds (painting-company row 326)
Merge claude/project-thread-du8lcn: 1.1's store slides tooling, What's New, and a release workflow (painting-company rows 318, 236)
Merge claude/project-thread-8wig4r: the length chip's chosen row shows its time (painting-company row 305)
Merge claude/hide-drawing-tile: hide A Drawing on Paper (painting-company row 190)
Merge claude/dynamic-type-own-tiles: allow the audit's false flags on Your Own's tiles

apps.versionDescription: Merge claude/project-thread-9cwdgx: lively paint, kit paint's hues spread, in SideStore builds (painting-company row 326)

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Paint by Moonlight uses the camera to take a photo you can turn into a paint-by-numbers picture. The photo stays on your device.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Paint by Moonlight saves a painting or its time-lapse to your photo library when you choose Save Image or Save Video as you share it.

apps.name: Beanbox
apps.subtitle: Paper for every jelly bean
apps.localizedDescription: Match origami paper to jelly bean flavours. Measure sheets and beans from photos, get the best sheet for every flavour, and split look-alike beans into groups, entirely on device.

versions.localizedDescription: Nothing has to be white; the printable mat is gone
Chart gridlines are solid hairlines; flavour labels take turns above and below
CI: one macOS job per push — screenshots on branches, the IPA on main

apps.versionDescription: Nothing has to be white; the printable mat is gone

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Beanbox uses the camera to photograph paper and beans so it can measure their colours. Photos stay on your device.

apps.name: Treasurr
apps.subtitle: Your seedbox, in your pocket
apps.localizedDescription: A personal dashboard for a self-hosted media server: live speeds, who's watching, downloads, service status and fun watch stats. Pairs with its own gateway by QR code; it does nothing without one.

versions.localizedDescription: CLAUDE.md: CI runs on Paul's MacBook
CI: build only main, pull requests and ci/<name> branches
CI: give the App Store Connect secrets only to the steps that use them
Watch while recording: the remote in Live TV (A26)
Polish Paul's TV: one close button, readable bars and hints, large text, plain reasons

apps.versionDescription: CLAUDE.md: CI runs on Paul's MacBook

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown on your seedbox.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Treasurr locks with Face ID and asks again before changing anything.
